_comment: Hand-authored mock plan. All values in METRES. position is the MIN CORNER of the item's box, not its center.
Bag frame: origin at the inner floor corner of the interior; X = width, Y = up, Z = depth.
Demo suitcase interior is 16 x 6 x 24 in => 0.4064 x 0.1524 x 0.6096 m, so every placement satisfies
The cavity is only 15.24 cm tall, so this is a two-layer bag, not three. Layout:
end-well  Z 0.00-0.17, full height  - shoes and the dopp kit stand upright in the short end.
base      Z 0.17-0.6096, Y 0.00-0.075  - flat soft goods.
upper     Z 0.17-0.6096, Y 0.075-0.1524 - second layer over the base.
The three zones are disjoint. Every pair of items is separated on at least one axis; the shoes and the
dopp kit touch at X = 0.30, which is contact, not overlap.

placements.label: Running shoes
placements.note: Soles down, side by side, pushed flush into the end corner. Stuff socks inside.

placements.label: Toiletry kit
placements.note: Stood on end beside the shoes, zip facing up.

placements.label: Folded jeans
placements.note: Flat across the full width, starting just past the shoes.

placements.label: Rolled sweater
placements.note: Rolled along the width and pressed into the far end of the base layer.

placements.label: Stack of shirts
placements.note: Second layer, resting on the jeans with the folded edges outward.

placements.label: Laptop sleeve
placements.note: Flat on the very top so it comes out first at security.
